skill_ideas.name: ghc-family-continuous-time-generator-review

skill_ideas.acceptance: Exact finite generator fixtures and negative-rate refusals

skill_ideas.purpose: Provide a checkable partition certificate and an explicit violating state pair for aggregation
skill_ideas.acceptance: A certificate binds the exact kernel, partition and block-transition sums

skill_ideas.name: ghc-family-observation-model-bridge
skill_ideas.purpose: Bind an observable, units, calibration and source to a proposed model comparison
skill_ideas.acceptance: Missing empirical mappings remain explicit and cannot be replaced by a synthetic pass

skill_ideas.name: ghc-family-consent-evidence-lifecycle-review
skill_ideas.purpose: Separate synthetic scope matching from actual issuer, subject, expiry, withdrawal and review evidence
skill_ideas.acceptance: Every real authority decision has its own competent and affected evidence

skill_ideas.name: ghc-family-comparison-budget-parity

skill_ideas.acceptance: Mismatched budgets and same-owner provenance are visible
